title: Practice 2: The family of писа́ть (письмо, писа́тель)

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **списке** — спи́сок: list, register, roll (register or roll of paper consisting of an enumeration or compilation of a set of possible items); handwritten or handpainted copy (especially of a manuscript or a religious icon). Wiktionary: с- + писа́ть + -ок.

exercises.why: From Wiktionary: описа́ние — description; пи́сьменный — written; подписа́ть — to sign (one's own name); вы́писать — to sign out.
